data.title: 伊冯 · 自助照相机吐出四格相纸
data.description: 街市收摊前，伊冯从自助照相机的取纸口抽出刚印好的四格相纸，举到灯箱旁端详。莓粉连帽外套敞开，银扣在梅紫工装短裙腰间一闪。她朝最后一格里自己眯起的眼睛笑了一声。
data.location: 终末地街市自助照相机旁
data.action: 抽出四格相纸举到灯箱边低头看
data.lighting: 灯箱白光照亮相纸和面颊，街口带微弱紫色余光
data.promptProse: Yvonne pulls a fresh strip of four photos from a booth in the closing street market. Her berry-pink hoodie hangs open over a cropped white tee, a silver buckle at the waist of her plum cargo skirt. She tips the paper into the booth light and laughs at her narrowed eyes in the last frame.
data.animaCaption: The strip of photos bends in one hand as she leans closer to see the last frame.
